rules.statement: When the rights of one party will be affected by the result of an action, and that party has a legal right enforceable against another party to the action which will be affected by the result, they should be joined as a party.
rules.supporting_quote: "it is sufficient if the main evidence and the main inquiry will be the same. Even if the narrower construction is adopted a person who has to be bound by the result of the action, or has a legal right enforceable by him against one of the parties to the action which will be affected by the result of the action should be joined"

meta.parties: Arumugam Coomaraswamy v. Andris Appuhamy and Others
